name: Whitefield
trend_summary: Prices have risen ~9% over the past 12 months driven by IT sector hiring and ITPL/EPIP zone expansion. Demand remains strong in the 80L–1.5Cr segment.
metro_access_summary: Purple Line (Baiyappanahalli–Whitefield) now operational. Most societies are 10–25 minutes by auto or cab to the nearest metro station. Walking access is limited.
airport_noise_summary: Not in airport noise zone. No significant aircraft noise concerns.
traffic_summary: Significant peak-hour congestion on Varthur Road and ITPL Main Road. Residents typically budget 45–90 minutes for commutes to Central or South Bengaluru during peak hours.
waterlogging_summary: Varthur lake overflow has caused localised flooding in low-lying areas during heavy monsoon. Properties above ground floor in higher-elevation societies are generally unaffected.
livability_summary: Strong IT-centric neighbourhood with good retail, hospitals, and schools. Weekend options have improved significantly. Best suited for IT professionals working in the Whitefield corridor.
community_notes: Varthur lake pollution is a long-standing concern. The lake restoration project is ongoing but buyers near the lake should verify flood history.

name: Sarjapur Road
trend_summary: Strong appreciation over the past 18 months. Proximity to Bellandur, Electronic City, and Outer Ring Road tech parks drives consistent demand. Premium projects command 12,000+ per sqft.
metro_access_summary: No metro line currently. Proposed Yellow Line will pass through the corridor but timelines are uncertain. Residents are dependent on road transport.
traffic_summary: Sarjapur Road is one of Bengaluru's most congested corridors. Peak-hour travel from Sarjapur to Silk Board can take 60–90 minutes for 10km. The proposed road widening is ongoing.
waterlogging_summary: Some low-lying stretches near Sarjapur town face seasonal waterlogging. Most integrated townships are elevated and unaffected.
livability_summary: Growing rapidly with good schools, hospitals, and retail infrastructure. Strong demand from families and IT professionals working in Bellandur-ORR corridor. Best avoided by those commuting to North or West Bengaluru.
community_notes: Most repeated concern on forums is the Sarjapur Road traffic. Buyers should stress-test their commute route during peak hours before committing.

name: Bellandur
trend_summary: Prices stabilised after strong run-up in 2022–2024. Premium micro-market driven by proximity to ORR tech parks. Less upside potential now; more of a quality-of-life buy.
metro_access_summary: Outer Ring Road metro corridor (Green Line extension) is planned but not yet operational near Bellandur. Current metro access requires travel to Marathahalli or Silk Board.
traffic_summary: ORR near Bellandur junction is one of Bengaluru's worst traffic points. Within Bellandur, internal roads are manageable. The ORR-Sarjapur junction is a known daily pain point.
waterlogging_summary: Bellandur lake has a well-documented history of pollution and occasional flooding of adjacent low-lying roads. Properties within 500m of the lake warrant careful investigation.
livability_summary: Premium residential zone with excellent walkability within societies and strong amenity access. The Bellandur lake environmental situation is a long-standing concern that depresses some buyers.
community_notes: Bellandur lake odour is real and seasonal — worse in summer. Visit at different times of year before buying near the lake. Farther-from-lake societies in Bellandur are generally unaffected.

name: HSR Layout
trend_summary: HSR Layout commands a premium as one of Bengaluru's most mature and walkable residential neighbourhoods. Price growth has moderated but values are sticky. Strong rental demand keeps investors engaged.
metro_access_summary: No direct metro line currently. Yellow Line is planned via HSR. Nearest metro is Silk Board (Green/Yellow interchange) — typically 15–20 minutes by cab.
traffic_summary: Internal HSR roads are reasonably managed. Main arterials like 27th Main and Sarjapur Road junction get congested at peak hours. Last-mile from metro is manageable.
waterlogging_summary: Generally good drainage. Some older sectors have had isolated waterlogging in heavy rain. Not a systemic concern compared to lower-lying areas.
livability_summary: Arguably Bengaluru's best residential neighbourhood for walkability, cafes, restaurants, and startup culture proximity. Premium priced but consistently in high demand. Scarcity of good inventory keeps prices elevated.

recurring_concerns: pricing out of range for many buyers
small apartment sizes at this budget

community_notes: HSR is consistently the most desired address in Bengaluru for young professionals. Inventory is scarce — good listings move quickly.

name: North Bengaluru
trend_summary: North Bengaluru (Hebbal, Yelahanka, Devanahalli corridor) is seeing strong appreciation driven by airport proximity, Manyata Tech Park, and large project launches. Significant runway for growth if airport traffic continues expanding.
metro_access_summary: Yellow Line (RV Road–Bommasandra) is operational partially. Airport metro line extension is planned but not complete. Current metro access is limited for most North Bengaluru locations.
airport_noise_summary: Airport noise is a real concern in Hebbal and Devanahalli areas depending on flight path rotation. Units on higher floors facing specific directions are more exposed. Visit at different times and ask about specific tower exposure.
traffic_summary: Hebbal flyover is a persistent bottleneck. NH44 to Devanahalli is generally clear outside peak hours. Internal Yelahanka and Hennur roads are manageable.
waterlogging_summary: Not a major systemic concern. Some areas near Hebbal lake have seen localised flooding. Generally better drainage than East or South Bengaluru.
livability_summary: Strong growth story but still maturing in terms of walkability, retail, and social infrastructure. Best for professionals working at Manyata, KIAL zone, or frequent flyers. Less suitable for those working in South or East Bengaluru.
community_notes: Airport noise is the most frequently mentioned concern on Bengaluru real estate forums for this zone. It is real but varies significantly by location, floor, and facing. Always verify on-site.
